_doc: Non-file work products that belong to the WBS but live outside the repo. Each entry hangs off a stream (default 00-program-management) and shows up as a synthetic leaf parented to a synthetic capability `deliverables` under that stream. Hand-curated; ~15 entries max so the list stays meaningful.

deliverables.name: Lock baseline project schedule
deliverables.evidence: Baseline must be agreed and frozen in /p6-xml before the team can earn value against it.
